nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
uint32 counter of the current game round; incremented in startNewGame and emitted in events.
uint256 accumulated ETH contributed by players; increased by msg.value in addPlayer.
ContractParam holding the pending configuration written by changeConfig.
ContractParam holding the active configuration used by addPlayer and gameResult.
Dynamic address[] list of players of the current round; cleared in startNewGame.
Deploy-time constructor: sets owner, initializes setConfig/curConfig and starts the first game.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to newOwner if it is not the zero address.
Owner-only payable function that stages new totalSize, singlePrice and pumpRate into setConfig.
Private function that increments gameIndex, copies setConfig into curConfig and clears addressArray.
Payable entry point: validates msg.value, accumulates totalPrice, records msg.sender and may finalize the round.
Public view returning gameIndex, current config values, the player array and totalPrice.
Private view counting how many times msg.sender appears in addressArray.
Private round settlement: picks a random winner, splits the balance between owner and winner and pays out.
Private view that derives a pseudo-random index from blockhash/now and the player array.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, player registration and identity checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp (now) consumed by the randomness generation in getRamdon.
owner.transfer(giveToOwn) external ETH transfer executed inside gameResult.
lastAddress.transfer(giveToActor) external ETH transfer to the pseudo-random winner.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(ramdon, now, blockhash(block.number-1))) randomness that is predictable and timestamp dependent.
totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value addition on unchecked uint256 state.
totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100 arithmetic used to split the pot, vulnerable to rounding/overflow.
Constructor parameter _totalSize used to seed setConfig and curConfig.
Constructor parameter _singlePrice (multiplied by 1 finney) used to seed setConfig and curConfig.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner assigned to the owner state variable.
changeConfig parameter _totalSize written into setConfig.totalSize.
changeConfig parameter _singlePrice (multiplied by 1 finney) written into setConfig.singlePrice.
changeConfig parameter _pumpRate written into setConfig.pumpRate.
Local index in gameResult holding the value returned by getRamdon().
Local address in gameResult read from addressArray[index]; the round winner.
Local snapshot of address(this).balance captured at the start of gameResult.
Local payout amount for the owner derived from the balance split.
Local payout amount for the winning player derived from the balance split.
Loop counter in getSelfCount counting matches of msg.sender in addressArray.
Loop index of the iteration over addressArray in getSelfCount.
Local bytes32 randomness accumulator repeatedly hashed inside getRamdon.
Local index returned by getRamdon as uint(ramdon) % addressArray.length.
Loop index of the iteration over addressArray used to mix randomness in getRamdon.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender is pushed into addressArray when a player joins.
msg.sender is compared against each addressArray entry inside getSelfCount.
Constructor _totalSize initializes setConfig.totalSize.
Constructor _singlePrice initializes setConfig.singlePrice.
Constructor _totalSize initializes curConfig.totalSize.
Constructor _singlePrice initializes curConfig.singlePrice.
newOwner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable in transferOwnership.
changeConfig _totalSize is written into setConfig.totalSize.
changeConfig _singlePrice is written into setConfig.singlePrice.
changeConfig _pumpRate is written into setConfig.pumpRate.
startNewGame copies the pending setConfig values into curConfig when hasChange is set.
addPlayer requires msg.value to equal curConfig.singlePrice and uses curConfig.totalSize.
gameIndex is emitted in GameOverEvent during settlement.
gameIndex is emitted in addPlayerEvent and incremented per round.
addressArray is indexed to select the winning address in gameResult.
addressArray entries and its length feed the pseudo-random index in getRamdon.
getRamdon produces the weak, miner-influenced randomness used to pick the winner.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed into the randomness source, making the result timestamp dependent.
addPlayer performs the unchecked totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value accumulation.
totalPrice is returned by getGameInfo.
curConfig.pumpRate supplies the split ratio used by the payout arithmetic.
The contract balance is multiplied by pumpRate and divided by 100, vulnerable to rounding and overflow.
giveToOwn is computed as totalBalace * pumpRate / 100.
giveToActor is computed as totalBalace - giveToOwn.
giveToOwn is the amount sent to owner via owner.transfer.
The owner address receives the protocol share through the external transfer.
giveToActor is the amount sent to the winner via lastAddress.transfer.
lastAddress is the recipient of the winner payout.
The pseudo-random index returned by getRamdon selects lastAddress from addressArray.
gameResult stores the value returned by getRamdon into the local index.
The constructor calls startNewGame at the end of deployment.
addPlayer calls gameResult when addressArray reaches curConfig.totalSize.
addPlayer calls startNewGame after settling a completed round.
gameResult calls getRamdon to choose the winning index.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeConfig is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
getSelfCount loops over addressArray using the local index i.
getRamdon loops over addressArray using the local index i.
The external owner.transfer call is made before the round state is reset, leaving a reentrancy surface for gameResult.
The external send to lastAddress can re-enter the contract while settlement state is not yet cleared.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only feeds setConfig/curConfig initialization and has no independent behavior.
The constructor parameter only feeds setConfig/curConfig initialization and has no independent behavior.
newOwner is solely used to assign the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
The parameter is only written into setConfig.totalSize within changeConfig.
The parameter is only written into setConfig.singlePrice within changeConfig.
The parameter is only written into setConfig.pumpRate within changeConfig.
The index local exists only to pick the winner inside gameResult.
lastAddress is the recipient variable of the winner transfer and is fully consumed by that unsafe operation.
totalBalace is the raw balance snapshot consumed only by the payout arithmetic.
giveToOwn is the computed amount passed directly into owner.transfer.
giveToActor is the computed amount passed directly into lastAddress.transfer.
count is the accumulator of the getSelfCount loop and has no meaning outside it.
The loop index i is confined to the getSelfCount iteration.
The ramdon accumulator is only used to build the pseudo-random hash chain in getRamdon.
The returned modulo index is produced and returned entirely inside getRamdon.
The loop index i is confined to the getRamdon randomness mixing loop.
